text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhh! I pulled it off,
damn it all!!

A stellar run in a Junior Class GⅠ. Vodka cleared an insanely
high hurdle through sheer grit and willpower!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is my power!
Dammit, dammit all...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, this is a piece of cake!
You all better remember the name Vodka!

She greets the stands and coolly leaves the turf.
And then...

With the big race behind us, we decided to have a modest
year-end celebration, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Today really took it out of me...
I'm completely wiped out...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
J-Just a little bit, okay?!
I'll feel better in no time, though!
choice_data_list: You don't have to push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Don't be so nice to me. When you say stuff like that,
I can't even act tough anymore...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm really beat this time, no joke.
I managed to play it cool, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Running cool in the Twinkle Series
is crazy tough work, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha, you've got way too many, geez...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's what I decided for myself.
All I can do is see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A lot happened during our first year, but...
Thanks to you, I got to run lookin' cooler than ever.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Only a handful of folks can even make it into a GⅠ in the Junior Class, after all. Thanks...

Looking back, it's safe to say
it was a flawless start.

And when I told her we had to choose
the next target race...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*urp*... I feel like I'm gonna burp.
I'm already stuffed, there's no way I can handle another...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, let's see... When it comes to next year's goals,
the first thing that comes to mind is...”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I know, but come on~. Give me a break for now.
Think of that as the big ultimate goal, and first..."

"There are two routes in the Classic races:
the 'Triple Crown route' and the 'Tiara route'."

The Derby is the second leg of the Triple Crown route.
It's customary to run the first leg, the Satsuki Sho, beforehand, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I get the Satsuki Sho and all. But before that, give me something a bit more manageable, please.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pick out a lively spot that's just right for stepping.

"When it comes to prep races for the Satsuki Sho,
there are races like the Yayoi Sho and Spring Stakes."

As I was pondering what would suit Vodka best
—
(BAAAANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The Tulip Sho!

A certain girl suddenly barged in and threw out
an utterly outlandish race name...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, just when I'm exhausted,
someone even more exhausting shows up...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka, I saw how you ran.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No, "I didn't mean to look, but I ended up seeing it" is more accurate.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I told you, I don't care either way.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: For your first GI, you did pretty well for yourself, didn't you? But...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you an even greater run than that!
At the Classic trial race, the Tulip Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A run superior to mine... you say?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's right. In the end, you only got good results off a spur-of-the-moment competitive streak.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm different. I'll show you true running, backed by real strength.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: See ya!

Daiwa Scarlet stormed off like a hurricane.
Seeing Vodka deliver such a stellar run
must have frustrated her to no end.

"Getting back on topic, I ask Vodka whether
she prefers the Yayoi Sho or the Spring Stakes..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The Tulip Sho!

Now Vodka had started spouting
something outrageous as well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, let's see you try!
If you can run better than me, do it right before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't think today is the end for me.
Next year, I'll show you running that blows today right out of the water!
choice_data_list: Are you sure the Tulip Sho is the right choice?
Are you really okay with the Tulip Sho?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? If I run in that, does it mean...
I won't be able to run in the Derby or something?

...That is not the case.
It is simply that the Tulip Sho is the trial race for the Oka Sho, the first leg of the Tiara line.
When I explained that it was an uncommon rotation...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If all you're gonna do is ignore 'em, fine by me.
Now that you've picked a fight, I ain't staying quiet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled!
Let's do this, Tulip!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Common sense doesn't apply to me.
It's not about where you run. It's about how you run!
